messages:
marta: Quick sync 14 partners requested final wave priority and press embargo windows for H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi. Need to lock by EOD Wed so marketing can prep. Key Qs: which models in Wave A, embargo phasing, SI onramp policy.

sam: My proposal: Wave A = H100 + Gaudi preview (small, low-risk headline). Wave B = H200 GA + MI300 broader listing. Wave C = remaining SKUs and region rollouts. SI preview: opt-in 2-3 SIs for Wave A canaries.

raj: Sounds good. MI300 supply still uncertain 14 we should publish a fallback mapping to H200 (or H100) for customers that requested MI300. That mapping must be explicit in marketplace terms.

elena: Tentative timeline: - Wave A (announce + limited marketplace listing): week of 2025-04-21 - SI preview enrollments: 2025-04-21 to 2025-05-05 - Wave B (broader GA + MI300 listing): week of 2025-05-05

tim-sv: Vendor heads-up: H200 microcode may slip ~1 week. If so, move H200 to Wave C and keep H100 in Wave A. Vendors request a 72h embargo clear window before press pickup.

michelle-marketing: 72h buffer OK. Need final asset list by Tue COB: one-pager, benchmark blurb, partner quotes. Also require vendor signoff on any performance numbers. :memo:

marta: Action items: @sam document Wave A/B/C SKU mapping and fallback matrix (due Tue 12pm PT); @raj compile MI300 supply risk note + fallback rules (due Tue 3pm PT); @tim-sv confirm firmware slip windows and publish embargo buffer (due Tue EOD); @michelle-marketing confirm asset checklist and announce cadence (due Tue COB).

nvidia-prod-bot: Vendor update: NVIDIA confirms H100 GA week-of-2025-04-21; H200 microcode ETA 2025-05-02 (subject to change).

sam: Question: allow "model-agnostic pool" marketplace option that routes to cheapest compatible card? This affects SKU naming and routing docs.

marta: Yes, allow model-agnostic pools but require explicit opt-in checkbox and warning about perf variance. Document in SKU terms.

elena: Also: console observability needs separate rows for Wave A preview SKUs to prevent early telemetry from skewing baseline metrics.

tim-sv: I'll add tag schema: wave:A_preview, wave:B_ga, fallback:H200->H100 mapping. Will update infra docs.

michelle-marketing: If Wave A locks tomorrow, I'll draft embargoed press brief and share a Google Doc for review Tue morning. :thumbsup:

marta: If no objections by EOD Wed we ship. Thanks everyone.
